The '''2016–17 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team''' represented [[Syracuse University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Orange were led by 41st-year head coach [[Jim Boeheim]] and played their home games at the [[Carrier Dome]] in [[Syracuse, New York]]. They were fourth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). They finished the season 19–15, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a three-way tie for seventh place. They lost in the second round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to [[2016–17 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami (FL)]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/college/acc/university-of-miami/article137202938.html|title=Miami Hurricanes hold off Syracuse at ACC tournament|first=Michael J.|last=Lewis|work=[[Miami Herald]]|date=March 8, 2017|access-date=February 6, 2024}}</ref> They were one of the last four teams not selected for the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and thus received a No. 1 seed in the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]] in the first round to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2016–17 Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball team|Ole Miss]].

==Previous season==
The [[2015–16 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Orange]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 23–14, 9–9 in [[2015-16 ACC Men's Basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place. They lost to [[2015–16 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] in the second round of the [[2006 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 10 seed where they defeated [[2015–16 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]], [[2015–16 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Middle Tennessee]], [[2015–16 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]], and [[2015–16 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] to reach the Final Four for the sixth time in school history. At the Final Four, the Orange lost to [[2015–16 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]].
